page_title: Remotely Operated Vehicle Deep Discoverer - NOAA Ocean Exploration
publisher: NOAA Office of Ocean Exploration and Research
contents: ROV Deep Discoverer launched off Okeanos Explorer's deck into the sea, control-room shot, then the ROV descending through blue to dark water with lights on. Has the feature's narration (voice of ROV pilot Dan Rogers) and music — mute or duck it. Best available is 720p.
